rule: No method below is an Athena capability or production feature. No performance claim is made for a method that has not been run. Every paid call needs a budget approved before the first call.

plans.method: Hermes persona routing (agent / model / tool route selection)
plans.purpose: Measure whether the right agent, model or tool route is chosen for a task given task type, cost, latency and evidence needs.
plans.hypothesis: A route chosen from the task's declared type, consequence and evidence need matches the oracle-best route on at least 80 % of tasks at no more than 1.2x the cost of the cheapest adequate route.
plans.baseline: Fixed default route (single strong model + deterministic checks); oracle-best route computed after the fact from all routes' measured outcomes.
plans.dataset_task_family: Athena task log families: bounded decisions (decision-corpus-v1), governance questions (council case set), report narration; synthetic and public-documentation tasks only.
plans.metric: Route accuracy vs oracle; regret in cost and latency; critical-miss rate of the chosen route.
plans.budget: USD 15 provider cost cap; local models count 0.
plans.stopping_rule: Stop at the cost cap, at > 5 % harness failures after one retry, or when collection completes. Stop before evaluation if no route differs from the default on calibration (no headroom).
plans.production_admission_gate: Route accuracy CI lower bound >= 0.8 and critical-miss rate not higher than the default route on a held-out split; shadow mode next to the existing router before any authority.
plans.current_status: NOT_RUN. The routing rule of the Athena Hermes persona has not been measured. Unrelated to the Nous Research Hermes agent runtime, which is not embedded in Athena.

plans.purpose: Measure whether executable computation, instead of natural-language reasoning, increases correctness on numeric calculation, metric verification, feature statistics and tabular analysis.
plans.hypothesis: On numeric tabular questions, PoT (model writes code, sandbox executes it, model explains the result) answers at least 10 percentage points more questions correctly than direct natural-language answers.
plans.baseline: Direct single-model answer; Athena's canonical deterministic computation as the ground truth.
plans.dataset_task_family: Metric recomputation, feature statistics, threshold arithmetic and split-validity checks on public datasets (UCI Adult, Bank Marketing, Telco).
plans.metric: Exact-answer accuracy (numeric tolerance stated per task); execution failure rate; cost and latency per answer.
plans.budget: USD 10 provider cost cap; sandbox execution only, no network.
plans.stopping_rule: Cost cap; > 5 % sandbox failures; or completion. Stop before evaluation if the direct baseline is >= 95 % correct on calibration.
plans.production_admission_gate: Accuracy gain CI excludes 0; no sandbox escape in the security suite; every number in a narrative traceable to an executed computation.
plans.current_status: NOT_RUN as a method comparison. Evidence enforcement (numbers come from canonical computation, the model only explains them) is wired in part of the reporting path; that is not a measured PoT result.

plans.purpose: Measure the accuracy, calibration and cost difference of chain-of-thought prompting against a single-step answer.
plans.hypothesis: CoT prompting improves accuracy on adversarial and ambiguous governance cases without worsening calibration (ECE) and at no more than 3x output tokens.
plans.baseline: Single-step answer of the same model and temperature.
plans.dataset_task_family: Council case families with measured solo headroom (new case set, >= 15 % solo error on calibration).
plans.metric: Accuracy, ECE, Brier, critical-miss rate, tokens, latency.
plans.stopping_rule: Headroom screen fails (solo error < 15 % on calibration) -> NOT_RUN — CEILING; cost cap; or completion.
plans.production_admission_gate: Accuracy gain CI excludes 0 and ECE not worse; raw chain-of-thought is never stored or shown.
plans.current_status: NOT_RUN with a real provider. The existing 'chain aggregation' is a confidence multiplier over council answers (tie-break behaviour) and is not labelled as real CoT.

plans.purpose: Measure whether exploring several candidate reasoning paths improves result quality on hard tabular and modelling decisions.
plans.hypothesis: Model-scored tree search over candidate decisions improves accuracy on hard model-selection and validation-interpretation cases by at least 10 percentage points over a single path.
plans.baseline: Single-path answer; CoT arm of research_cot.
plans.dataset_task_family: Model selection and validation interpretation cases with measured solo headroom.
plans.metric: Accuracy, critical-miss rate, calls, tokens, latency.
plans.production_admission_gate: Accuracy gain CI excludes 0 at an accepted cost multiple; deterministic re-check of the chosen decision.
plans.current_status: NOT_RUN with a real provider. The existing 'tree aggregation' scores branches from returned text and makes no model calls of its own.

plans.purpose: Measure whether graph-based reasoning improves interdependent decisions such as feature engineering, model selection and error analysis.
plans.hypothesis: Reasoning over a dependency graph of related decisions reduces contradictory decisions across a run by at least half compared with independent per-decision answers.
plans.baseline: Independent per-decision single-model answers; deterministic Athena pipeline.
plans.dataset_task_family: Multi-step runs on public datasets where feature, model and error-analysis decisions depend on each other.
plans.metric: Cross-decision contradiction rate, final model quality on a locked test split, cost, latency.
plans.production_admission_gate: Contradiction reduction CI excludes 0 with no loss of locked-test quality.
plans.current_status: NOT_RUN with a real provider. The existing 'graph consensus' is an aggregation over council answers; the preprocessing 'GoT' graph is a decision trace built after the fact and changes nothing.

plans.purpose: Identify the task classes where a council, judge or critic beats the single-model baseline, and the conditions under which the added cost and latency buy a benefit.
plans.hypothesis: On cases with measured solo headroom, a role-diverse council with a protective-minority veto lowers the critical-miss rate versus the strong single model without raising the false-alarm rate by more than 5 percentage points.
plans.baseline: Strong single model (condition A of the 2026-11-04 ablation).
plans.dataset_task_family: New governance case set (>= 60 calibration, >= 150 evaluation), admitted only when two human reviewers agree on the answer; run through the product council endpoint so validator agreement and tenant context are measured.
plans.metric: Critical-miss rate, false-alarm rate, accuracy, cost, latency (paired bootstrap, 2 000 resamples, fixed seed).
plans.budget: USD 25 hard cap (the full 2026-11-04 run cost USD 0.71 provider-reported over 1 506 distinct calls).
plans.stopping_rule: Strong model >= 85 % on calibration -> NOT_RUN — CEILING; cost cap -> STOPPED — COST_CAP; > 5 % call failures after one retry; completion.
plans.production_admission_gate: Critical-miss reduction CI upper bound < 0, false-alarm increase <= 0.05, validator agreement measured; escalation only (never a default path, never global orchestration).
plans.current_status: MEASURED once: REJECTED_ON_THIS_BENCHMARK (ceiling, 70/71). This does not show that councils never work. Follow-up plan prepared, NOT_RUN.

plans.purpose: Measure whether tool use reduces the error rate on data-validation and operational tasks compared with text-only reasoning.
plans.hypothesis: A bounded ReAct loop over read-only tools halves the error rate on data-validation questions compared with text-only answers.
plans.baseline: Text-only single-model answer; deterministic validator result as ground truth.
plans.dataset_task_family: Data-validation and operational questions answerable from read-only tools (schema, profile, metric, capability status) on synthetic tenants.
plans.metric: Error rate, tool calls per task, loop-limit hits, cost, latency.
plans.budget: USD 15 provider cost cap; read-only tools only.
plans.stopping_rule: Cost cap; any write attempt (fails the run); completion.
plans.production_admission_gate: Error-rate reduction CI excludes 0; zero write side effects; per-tenant tool grants enforced; loop and budget limits enforced.
plans.current_status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED, NOT_RUN. Natural-language orchestration is a deterministic intent planner with no tool loop.

plans.purpose: Measure whether a second attempt after validator feedback produces a measurable improvement over the first answer.
plans.hypothesis: One reflection step driven by validator findings corrects at least 30 % of first-attempt validator failures without introducing new failures in more than 5 % of cases.
plans.baseline: First attempt; a plain retry without feedback.
plans.dataset_task_family: Report narration and interpretation tasks where the evidence validator flags unsupported or contradicted claims.
plans.metric: Correction rate, new-error rate, validator pass rate, cost and latency of the extra step.
plans.stopping_rule: Cost cap; completion; stop early if the first-attempt failure rate on calibration is < 10 % (no headroom).
plans.production_admission_gate: Correction-rate CI excludes 0 and new-error rate <= 5 %; the validator, not the model, decides acceptance.
plans.current_status: NOT_RUN. One diagnose-and-retry step is wired (advisory, API only); it is not iterative Reflexion and has not been evaluated.

plans.purpose: Measure whether MCTS gives a cost-effective advantage over fixed HPO or heuristic search in wide feature and model strategy searches.
plans.hypothesis: At equal compute budget, MCTS over strategy choices (feature families, encodings, model families) reaches a better locked-test score than the existing heuristic search in at least 2 of 3 public datasets.
plans.baseline: Existing deterministic strategy search plus the HPO engine at the same compute budget; random search.
plans.dataset_task_family: Public tabular datasets (UCI Adult, Bank Marketing, Diabetes 130-US).
plans.metric: Locked-test score, compute time, number of evaluated pipelines.
plans.budget: Compute only (no provider cost); 8 CPU-hours cap.
plans.production_admission_gate: Score gain CI excludes 0 at equal budget on at least 2 of 3 datasets; no re-implementation of HPO.
